title: Checks that a TODO comment is labelled with "TODO".
summary: Ambiguous tags reduce code visibility and can lead to dangling TODOs. For example, if a comment is tagged with "FIXME" rather than "TODO", it may be overlooked by future readers. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-todos and made it stable in v0.0.269.

title: Checks that a TODO comment includes an author.
summary: Including an author on a TODO provides future readers with context around the issue. While the TODO author is not always considered responsible for fixing the issue, they are typically the individual with the most context. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-todos and made it stable in v0.0.269.
message_templates: Missing author in TODO; try: `# TODO(<author_name>): ...` or `# TODO @<author_name>: ...`

title: Checks that a TODO comment is associated with a link to a relevant issue or ticket.
summary: Including an issue link near a TODO makes it easier for resolvers to get context around the issue. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-todos and made it stable in v0.0.269.
message_templates: Missing issue link for this TODO

title: Checks that a "TODO" tag is followed by a colon.
summary: "TODO" tags are typically followed by a parenthesized author name, a colon, a space, and a description of the issue, in that order. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-todos and made it stable in v0.0.269.

title: Checks that a "TODO" tag contains a description of the issue following the tag itself.
summary: TODO comments should include a description of the issue to provide context for future readers. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-todos and made it stable in v0.0.269.

title: Checks that a "TODO" tag is properly capitalized (i.e., that the tag is uppercase).
summary: Capitalizing the "TODO" in a TODO comment is a convention that makes it easier for future readers to identify TODOs. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-todos and made it stable in v0.0.269.

title: Checks that the colon after a "TODO" tag is followed by a space.
summary: "TODO" tags are typically followed by a parenthesized author name, a colon, a space, and a description of the issue, in that order. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-todos and made it stable in v0.0.269.
message_templates: Missing space after colon in TODO
